definitions: Moving something or someone from one place to another.
Changing the ownership of something, especially property or money.
Moving data from one computer system or storage device to another.
Changing from one public transport vehicle to another to continue a journey.
examples: They are transferring the patient to a different hospital.
The bank is transferring funds between accounts.
He is transferring files to his new laptop.
She is transferring at the next station.
